actions.text: Dozer "Capepaw Road. Ten houses, ten gardens... and most of the gates are locked."
Dozer "And that's Scruff on the north pavement. Bushes to hide in, pebbles to throw. Or sharp claws, just in case."
Dozer "A black-and-white bird, shiny things vanishing... it's a magpie. It's got my collar. I know it."
